resources.string: Enable the private command and PRI drawer entry for Android Private Space on supported devices.

Private Space requires Android 15+, Re:TUI as your default launcher, and compatible device software. Some implementations, including certain Vivo/iQOO versions, may prevent locking, unlocking, or opening private apps. Use your phone’s Private Space interface if this happens.\n\nDisabling this option hides Re:TUI access; it does not lock Private Space. Save Settings to apply your choice.
The private command is disabled. Enable it in Behaviour settings under Commands.
